================================================================================
IMMEDIATE NEXT STEP: RUN THE EXAMPLE
================================================================================

$ cd /home/swarm/SwarmCode/TUI
$ CACHE_DEBUG=1 go test -v ./internal/chat -run TestComprehensiveTrace

This will:
  1. Create 8 numbered event files
  2. Create 1 NDJSON file with all events
  3. Show you the complete transformation flow
  4. Prove the system works

Output goes to: /tmp/tui-trace/test-session-123/

================================================================================
WHAT EACH FILE TYPE SHOWS
================================================================================

001_raw_sse_message_start.json
  ↳ Raw from Anthropic: message ID, model, initial usage

003_raw_sse_content_block_delta.json
  ↳ Raw from Anthropic: streamed text/thinking

005_raw_sse_message_delta.json
  ↳ Raw from Anthropic: FINAL metrics (this is key!)
     Shows: cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens

006_after_message_delta_.json
  ↳ Our extraction: calculated total_input_tokens

007_canonical_.json
  ↳ Provider format: message + usage + cache_metrics

008_final_message_.json
  ↳ Application format: ready to use

complete_trace_*.ndjson
  ↳ All 8 events in NDJSON (one per line)
     Easy to parse, search, and analyze

================================================================================
HOW TO DEBUG YOUR CACHE ISSUE
================================================================================

Your problem: Both requests show cache_creation (should be: create then read)

Solution: Compare event 005 from request 1 vs request 2

Request 1:
  jq '.raw_sse.usage' /tmp/tui-trace/session1/005_raw_sse_*.json
  
  Expected output:
  {
    "input_tokens": 10,
    "output_tokens": 6,
    "cache_creation_input_tokens": 15039,    ← Creating cache
    "cache_read_input_tokens": 0              ← Not reading
  }

Request 2 (< 5 minutes later):
  jq '.raw_sse.usage' /tmp/tui-trace/session2/005_raw_sse_*.json
  
  Expected output:
  {
    "input_tokens": 10,
    "output_tokens": 6,
    "cache_creation_input_tokens": 0,         ← NOT creating
    "cache_read_input_tokens": 15039          ← Reading cache!
  }

If Request 2 still shows cache_creation > 0:
  ✗ Cache not working
  ✗ Root cause is in: stream.go or translate.go
  ✗ Check: Are cache_control headers being sent?
  ✗ Check: Does system prompt have cache_control block?

================================================================================
INTEGRATION INTO YOUR CODE (When Ready)
================================================================================

Edit: sdk/provider/anthropic/stream.go

Line ~225, add:
  trace.LogRawSSEEvent(event.Type, data)

Edit: sdk/provider/anthropic/translate.go

Line ~1000, add:
  trace.LogCanonical(resp, nil)
  trace.LogFinalMessage(msg)

That's it! Enable with: export CACHE_DEBUG=1

Full details: COMPLETE_TRACE_INTEGRATION.md

================================================================================
KEY METRICS TO TRACK
================================================================================

These values tell you if cache is working:

First message:
  ✓ cache_creation_input_tokens should be ~15000
  ✓ cache_read_input_tokens should be 0
  ✓ Means: Creating cache with system prompt

Second message (< 5 min later):
  ✓ cache_creation_input_tokens should be ~100-200 (minor changes only)
  ✓ cache_read_input_tokens should be ~15000 (reading cache!)
  ✓ Means: Cache hit! Reusing system prompt

Token formula:
  total = input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens
  cost = (creation * $0.003) + (read * $0.0003) + (output * $0.002)

================================================================================
ANALYSIS COMMANDS
================================================================================

View complete trace as formatted JSON:
  jq '.' /tmp/tui-trace/test-session-123/complete_trace_*.ndjson

Follow cache through all stages:
  jq 'select(.cache_metrics) | {sequence, stage, cache_metrics}' \
    /tmp/tui-trace/test-session-123/complete_trace_*.ndjson

Compare request 1 vs 2:
  diff <(jq '.raw_sse.usage' /tmp/tui-trace/session1/005*) \
       <(jq '.raw_sse.usage' /tmp/tui-trace/session2/005*)

List all events by type:
  jq -r '.type' /tmp/tui-trace/test-session-123/complete_trace_*.ndjson | sort | uniq -c
